name: Multi-IF
intro: Multi-IF 把英文单轮 IFEval 扩展为三轮、八语言的可规则验证指令遵循基准。流程用 Llama 3.1 405B 生成后续轮次、识别跨轮冲突并翻译，再由人工完成冲突过滤、翻译修订与敏感内容删除，最终得到 4,501 段对话。
build_method: 自动生成, 机器翻译, 人工标注, 混合
metric: 指令级严格/宽松准确率, 对话级严格/宽松准确率
language: 英文, 法文, 印地文, 意大利文, 葡萄牙文, 中文, 西班牙文, 俄文
task_type: 指令遵循, 多轮对话
eval_feature: 三轮指令保持, 八语言, 跨轮冲突过滤, 严格与宽松规则评测
scale: 4,501 段三轮对话, 8 种语言
build_method_en: Automated Generation, Machine Translation, Human Annotation, Hybrid
eval_feature_en: Three-turn Instruction Retention, Eight Languages, Cross-turn Conflict Filtering, Strict and Loose Rule Evaluation
intro_en: Multi-IF expands English single-turn IFEval into a rule-verifiable benchmark with three-turn conversations in eight languages. Llama 3.1 405B generates follow-up turns, scans cross-turn conflicts, and translates prompts; humans then filter conflicts, revise translations, and remove sensitive content, yielding 4,501 conversations.

flowchart TD
    A[IFEval English Single-Turn Prompts] --> B[Multi-turn Expansion]
    B --> C{Instruction Type Sampling (30 types)}
    C --> D[LLM Prompt Generation (Llama 3.1 405B)]
    D --> E[Multi-turn Prompts (English)]
    E --> F{LLM Conflict Identification (Llama 3.1 405B)}
    F -- Conflicting --> G[Human Auditing (Conflict Resolution)]
    F -- No Conflict --> H[Clean English Multi-turn Prompts]
    G --> H
    H --> I[Multilingual Translation (Llama 3.1 405B)]
    I --> J{Multilingual Human Auditing & Revision}
    J -- Needs Revision --> I
    J -- Approved --> K[Translated Multilingual Prompts]
    K --> L{LLM Sensitive Content Flagging}
    L -- Sensitive --> M[Human Review & Elimination]
    L -- Not Sensitive --> N[Final Multilingual Conversations]
    M --> N
    N --> O[Dataset: 4,501 Multilingual Conversations (8 languages, 3 turns)]
    O --> P[Evaluation of SOTA LLMs (e.g., Llama 3.1, GPT-4o)]
    P --> Q(Performance Analysis: Multi-turn Accuracy, Multilingual Capabilities)
language_en: English, French, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, Chinese, Spanish, Russian
metric_en: Instruction-level Strict/Loose Accuracy, Conversation-level Strict/Loose Accuracy

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.15553 Sections 3–4 and the official Multi-IF repository. The diagrams preserve IFEval turn one, per-follow-up sampling from 30 instruction types, Llama 3.1 405B generation from prior prompts, LLM then human conflict filtering, translation into seven named languages with language-inapplicable constraints skipped, professional faithfulness and native-style review with 15% average rewriting, LLM flagging plus human sensitive-content removal, the 4,501-conversation/three-turn/eight-language release, cumulative response rollout, all four strict/loose instruction/conversation metrics, their average, and 14-model comparison.
